task.title: Inspect schedules by lifecycle status
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/827 by exposing the typed status projection through deterministic read-only CLI JSON.
acceptance_criteria: Accept only the four exact lifecycle status names before storage access.
Return complete matching projections in exact-ID order or an empty array.
Fail closed without partial output, storage creation, or mutation authority.

attempts.diagnostic: Focused tests failed because status was not a recognized schedule subcommand.
attempts.patch: Added focused integration coverage for the required success, absence or conflict, validation, and fail-closed paths.

attempts.summary: Implemented the bounded contract and refactored only demonstrated duplication.
attempts.diagnostic: The capability existed below the requested boundary or required one new typed kernel operation.
attempts.patch: Added status filtering, strict pre-storage validation, and shared inventory serialization over ScheduleStore::list_by_status.

outcome.summary: Operators can inspect schedules by exact lifecycle status without duplicating lifecycle semantics or gaining mutation authority.

lessons: Validate bounded enum spellings before filesystem access.
Reuse typed kernel filtering and one shared complete projection instead of interpreting state in scripts.
